repoDescription: portfolio-site — Node ESM, no TypeScript and no ESLint. Its real quality gate is SSSS: the vault must pass `ssss conformance --engine` against vault-registry/. Plus the node:test suite and a syntax sweep.

checks.description: Canonical gate for this repo — the vault must satisfy the SSSS engine contract. Wired as `npm run validate`.
There is no linter here, so parse every tracked .mjs as the floor gate.
node:test suite — light enough to stay in the default tier.
Vault must still package into a valid .ucw bundle (SSSS spec §16).
